description: Validate an HTML file that contains embedded AMPscript and/or SSJS blocks. Checks both languages and GTL template syntax. Set target to 'next' to flag MCN-unsupported AMPscript functions and all SSJS as errors.

code.description: HTML source that may contain %%[ ]%%, %%= =%%,  <script runat="server">, or {{ }} blocks.

maxProblems.description: Maximum number of problems to return (default 100).

target.description: Target platform. Use 'next' to flag MCN-incompatible code (unsupported AMPscript functions and all SSJS).

name: validate_sfmc_html
